company: Ten Technologies Group plc (formerly Ten Lifestyle Group plc)

facts.label: Active Members
facts.definition_or_caveat: The company defines Active Members as eligible members who used the platform in the previous twelve months. This is not MAU, DAU, unique login rows or total eligible members.

facts.label: Active Members (prior year)
facts.definition_or_caveat: Same Active Member definition as FY2026 comparator.

facts.label: HSBC UK Premier customers reached by new fully digital lifestyle platform
facts.definition_or_caveat: The trading update says the platform was launched to over one million customers. This is audience reach, not proven active users or registered database rows.

facts.label: Expected FY2026 Net Revenue
facts.definition_or_caveat: Approximately £69.7m expected; not a technology or cloud budget.

facts.label: Expected FY2026 Adjusted EBITDA
facts.definition_or_caveat: Approximately £16.1m expected; not a technology or cloud budget.

facts.label: Active Members
facts.definition_or_caveat: Active Members are users who used the platform in the previous twelve months; not monthly active users.

facts.label: Investment in technology, content and communications
facts.definition_or_caveat: Broad investment measure: includes proprietary digital platforms, technology, content and communications. It is not cloud/database spend.

facts.label: Investment in proprietary digital platforms, communications and technologies
facts.period: H1 FY2026, six months ended 28 February 2026
facts.definition_or_caveat: This broad investment measure is not cloud/database spend. A simple 2x annualisation is a run-rate illustration, not a forecast.

facts.label: Capitalised development spend
facts.period: H1 FY2026, six months ended 28 February 2026
facts.definition_or_caveat: Part of the £6.3m technology/platform/content/communications investment; capitalisation is an accounting treatment, not a cloud bill.

facts.label: Capitalised development cost additions
facts.definition_or_caveat: Internal expenditure added to the gross capitalised development asset during FY2025; not annual cloud operating cost.

facts.label: Gross capitalised development costs
facts.definition_or_caveat: Historical gross cost balance before accumulated amortisation and disposals. Not database size, replacement cost, or market value.

facts.label: Net carrying amount of capitalised development costs
facts.definition_or_caveat: Gross capitalised development cost less accumulated amortisation. This is an accounting book value for software development assets, not database or infrastructure valuation.

facts.label: Average monthly employees
facts.definition_or_caveat: Average monthly persons employed including directors: 191 UK and 997 international. Not a count of technology employees.

facts.label: Aggregate employee remuneration
facts.definition_or_caveat: Wages, salaries, social security, pension and share-based payments for the Group workforce. Not technology payroll alone.

facts.label: Ten Digital Platform availability
facts.definition_or_caveat: Platform availability scale; does not prove separate data-centre regions or database replication topology.

facts.label: Corporate client and supplier ecosystem
facts.value: 50+ corporate clients; thousands of suppliers; 20+ global service locations
facts.definition_or_caveat: Company-reported ecosystem scale. It does not disclose rows, records, contracts or per-client active usage.

facts.label: Tools named in Ten Data Engineer vacancy
facts.value: SQL, Python, AWS Lambda, AWS ECS, Airflow, Snowflake, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, GitHub and Jira
facts.period: Public Data Engineer job advertisement, reposted approximately one month before 30 October 2026
facts.definition_or_caveat: The advert labels these tools as 'Our Tech Stack' and describes pipelines, central data store, APIs/feeds, database optimisation and AWS or equivalent. This is evidence of advertised team requirements, not proof every production service uses all of them.

facts.label: Data platform responsibilities described in vacancy
facts.value: Data ingestion, normalisation, transformation, unified central data store, APIs/data feeds, data quality/governance, analytics delivery and database performance optimisation
facts.definition_or_caveat: Describes the advertised team's remit; not a published architecture diagram.

facts.label: Named internal/member-facing products
facts.value: Ten MAID (internal CRM/request management), Talia (AI-powered member assistant), Ten Copilot (agent assistant), Ten PX (member engagement/personalisation)
facts.definition_or_caveat: These product roles imply distinct operational data domains and workflows but do not disclose schemas, storage engines or service boundaries.

facts.label: Operating expenses per request
facts.definition_or_caveat: Company KPI statement; the public announcement does not define the request denominator or disclose request volumes.
